话说前段时间不是接父母过来嘛，但那之前儿子说想去吃王厚元，我说等爷爷奶奶来一起去吃吧，但是后来发现儿子也抽不出来时间和爷爷奶奶一起去饭店吃饭呀。

![20261014_123841.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYE4aF4KoPKR7X2tqgWLbt9ppEvd2dM3zKmjMFp54P4i/20261014_123841.jpg)

除了周日儿子休息外，平日上学都是早出晚归，真的是披星戴月呀，所以也就周日有机会能出去吃点所谓的大餐。

而父母过来的时候又恰巧是周一，完美错开周末，至于等下个周末嘛？父母又不肯在我们这待太长时间，哎，两难呀。

其实我也想过周日一早去接父母，不过周六那天我几乎跑了一整天医院，实在是累晕，周日一早那是一点精神和力气都没有，哪敢开车上高速呢。

既然如此，只能先带娃出去吃，等父母过来，再带父母去吃喽。

周日带娃去吃王厚元，我们要的辣木苗拌海蜇
![20261011_133730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZphYa76p8y4MA7a4fCJ2SdBQZ5pTzKbwzgD5N83idBjP/20261011_133730.jpg)

给他们娘俩要的蔬菜（我不爱吃哦）
![20261011_133737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCXYTqnHVq9bt4SwpaccbG81UoqeGATiSAUV6LFxmKGD/20261011_133737.jpg)

给娃要的拔丝三品（他最喜欢吃，我都吃腻歪啦）
![20261011_133741.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbP4J92EuSqwqVtzpf8eMGg4jJttBNGzfzawhWJjYAZux/20261011_133741.jpg)

环境一如既往的好，虽然是周日，但是我们去的晚，人也不多
![20261011_133752.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRv2JRzpFX836jEbxRngDJQJfweGc3EszRzcoxGXoPgN/20261011_133752.jpg)

打卡送的可乐雪碧
![20261011_133848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4WRaSsrNNnp9zQB3UAU8j2M5HyhgP3Rak4KppDpjNzm/20261011_133848.jpg)

给娃要的烧烤牛肉
![20261011_134726.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPGY8a8U9RibBvvwtZBk9Zy1wpoBq7tEffPxSgnJNn8to/20261011_134726.jpg)


话说父母过来后，在父亲的陪同下带母亲去做了术后复查，又折腾了几近一整天，可把我累晕了，还好一切都正常，再累也值得。

第二天原本计划带父母出去溜达溜达，但是他们也累我也累，那就出去吃大餐吧。

于是乎，我们四口人（娃在上学）又来到了王厚元餐厅，因为是周中，人更好
![20261014_122620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ9mY7JVw5f6XDuqWLXUT384iqsEwadGYPrFa2T7DNPkT/20261014_122620.jpg)

环境还是一如既往的好
![20261014_122630.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUmc3c313qmD3foUCVD6YNAAxHsvMiyQpGBziVwu1YS6W/20261014_122630.jpg)

酸菜白肉血肠
![20261014_123017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRHXi5kPDXWWkEqepJc8L8VfJ9YS3g3p3H11i2vrSvQ1y/20261014_123017.jpg)

海蜇皮拌娃娃菜
![20261014_123243.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSrEb3GgApPRDuY9WXh2W1dKSjWKLrCasbRpcmXP1jJq/20261014_123243.jpg)

蛋黄焗南瓜
![20261014_123509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTHVpXynDVnajuKA83ZHcjtA6LnU4BE4W9VKBSKSCapsK/20261014_123509.jpg)

香酥小河虾
![20261014_123630.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewwdY8WGSt2HrebXVH24mrsidq9uDC14VsSNtm7khHzc/20261014_123630.jpg)

老式锅包肉
![20261014_123807.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWA3f4xbu6HsiHRWZ6zHaUETq7uUHuhjVShhjL2z1VqMV/20261014_123807.jpg)

又给父母点了俩屉饺子
![20261014_123730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajT1Hmmh5Vjq19bWpiUui4iUkGPkJWB15tZPBX8a7uJE/20261014_123730.jpg)

满满一大桌
![20261014_123838.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZkjUTM5yt6NTeogUWmDNFiXQozq6pBMw4jG4mzLM4vio/20261014_123838.jpg)


酒足饭饱（我没喝酒哦，开车不喝酒，喝酒不开车）后，带他们去丁香湖溜达一圈
![20261014_133529.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYA3Xm2dobAtt2z8RahQqYugxYmhy1QAqRPmWYAQK9nTR/20261014_133529.jpg)

丁香湖这里弄了个沙滩，哈哈哈
![20261014_133535.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXvVzCnyzYJQsqcbNoEvSEvviKzLtog843XzMHsbm8euF/20261014_133535.jpg)

我准备盘下来养鸭子的湖心岛
![20261014_133547.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWBxW4bER1YXuDrzxz4ceWiiZUx6QVm7GrY4U8yKkNsHR/20261014_133547.jpg)

丁香湖现在人气是真不错，还不是周末呢，都停满了车
![20261014_133557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmepk6cZaqTp3xJJJCTVWsTyLWGEUV3tnYmzi69F3Fozsi/20261014_133557.jpg)

绕到大桥下休息一会
![20261014_134434.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRa3M1PrUkpQM8pxpaWQuS3KZCpHtZtBw6shkwv7KKvB/20261014_134434.jpg)

想在这多拍几张照片，可惜大家都累了，所以回家休息去啦
![20261014_134437.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmesDm9AnCW2rV7Ffy6KbNJVm2Jy9wr128Fv5Pw2bqFfhm/20261014_134437.jpg)

说起来，我好久没好好逛逛丁香湖啦，改天有时间去逛逛，好好地拍一组丁香湖之秋！

# Wish you and your family a Happy Dusherra - Celebration is the ultimate way to keep negativity away ![Happy Dussehra 2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/48PwZstvm4aBP1ikFyeH2ucrgp55jwJpP83QvafCqtwBMwni6Ud9gUJohiGfRUNdwY.jpg) As I wrote in my last [post](https://peakd.com/hive-126152/@sanjeevm/passing-the-wheels-of-tradition), **Dussehra** is fundamentally a celebration of the triumph of positive over negative energies. But have you ever paused to think about why we actively need these grand celebrations? ![20261018_193452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoiWDH1YPyphaycW2jTXwRfvBSM42VwffXFv6ddjJTVE4KSU6BrvsXUG3VhSobAp4H6.jpg) It boils down to a simple truth: Celebrations elevate our mood and take our mental state to the next level. If you sit alone inside your home for days on end without any activity, interaction, or festivity, negative energies quietly start creeping in. It aligns perfectly with the old saying, "An idle brain is an evil brain." By keeping our minds actively engaged in communal celebrations, we actively generate vibrant, positive energy. Frankly, it is the only true way to triumph over the persistent negative things in life. ![20261018_193302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoEr1k524e673HLt2UJzs6LkJzwzDEY7D9jtVYBxkpqhmnZabUfyF6pXyGrztzSkHu9.jpg) If you travel across India, you will witness countless happy faces everywhere - even among people who may not be wealthy or have many material possessions. Have you ever wondered why? It is because celebrations are deeply embedded in our culture and traditions. Our calendar is structured so beautiful that we have a festival almost every alternate week. People don't just observe them; they actively participate with full hearts. **Dussehra** stands out as one of our biggest festivals, spanning over ten spectacular days. It completely shifts the atmosphere, ushering in a warm, festive mood right as the winter chill begins to set in. ![20261018_191330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tSMiaY5U9CTm9SFgaDs8tzcnh6F7hszDU7umaTr4AyLwVUZyZmtqbpXkzwv3K4QDR6q.jpg) To soak in the spirit, we recently visited some of the local festival pandals nearby. The sheer scale is mind-blowing !!! Communities and organizers spend massive amounts of money to bring these structures to life. Yet, what we see locally is just a tiny glimpse. In some other places, celebrations are taken to an unimaginable level, featuring pandal decorations sculpted entirely out of real silver and gold. While it sounds extravagant, it is their way of channeling bright, radiant, and victorious energies into our lives. May be I will try to show it to you next year. ![20261018_193544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23xAVsmZSPDTwbgBb1shSf1fSzQzatch2h5WmdRT3sCC4qAQBLNvTsp3CZg96dnu4QDrJ.jpg) Every evening, you can see live music nights, traditional dance performances, and drama skits being organized right next to the pandals. Local artists and musicians get a grand platform, and the entire neighborhood gathers around to enjoy the melodies and rhythm, which adds another layer of joy to the festive spirit. ![20261020_115819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/Eos3DqwzXuGWKsgSSvSm4cLo97EDCpGGVvsvMCJkTTzZ2P28XZxwamyz4zEPezE1Mbr.jpg) Here are the photos of another pandal that the boy and me managed to visit today, having its own unique theme and beautiful craftsmanship. ![20261020_115446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/2423sCPwA3VYAbjuDSngCfAw2R9Cbpj6GXPnzazGUQCdfKyv7R2SkueydKAZCCYedEodW.jpg) ![20261020_115625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23uQtniGypCDtprPPE2DtA9TNxALLs2h4PwmUF3QAe33yd1z6D793JQa1JHqzXPPVXsMc.jpg) And this year our celebration was extended with some more happy moments - we had a Dandia night celebrated in our apartment society. Though there were few ladies, but they did celebrate it to the fullest, my wife joined them and did enjoy the evening, and we as a family joined to encourage her and other participants and capture some beautiful moments. ![20261019_201541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23wgKUZAzW2G9De54niovcDsSNjBwQgLvu2KPBS2X3VWohjvjbegn5dVi2Gtxq8ZbSWst.jpg) And then Red FM also came to our society celebrating the Puja on wheels event - more to come on those.... ***Shot with Samsung S25 Ultra*** ![Silver Bloggers.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/AK7y1CMyhCV3nuNidqMeSzXHYrzUgsAtry2cVQ5Xsfu7CdnBkpftSKoHCNouYcz.gif) ***Footer specially designed for the Silver Bloggers Community - the community of silvery "oldies" from the famous Generation X onward.......The place where we all keep our memories to share with the future. The library of a silly, wild bunch of Silvers. The Silvery Book of the Wise!*** ![hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23t7Yf2ig7CziqatXGLDSFvEXbGWpLghnimWmyzQWE2BichH69ZtADrPf9j3fQTtbt3cw.png)

Today I invite you to join me and see the market I visited in September, five weeks ago, that was organized as a joint event with the stuffed cabbage festival. Whenever there's a festival, there's a fair too, which is a very good occasion for local artisans to display their products and also make some money, as well as for visitors to buy some souvenirs. ![The Fair Of The Stuffed Cabbage Festival.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48TKp8rjHELtiSMDfEk1WgZx1LAfMiycXqzmRWpza3XkFvqgMVXo9i1HnzM3ak6mjP.jpg) These fairs are a lot of fun, but not harmless though, if you can't control your urge to buy something (or many things), you end up burning a hole in your pocket. Anyway, let's see what they had to offer visitors. ![20260913_120911a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpQxkCrVsBTE5uPW28AMeH9t2de4oTsRUuH8WM3N6PAamghpFPT3mTVg1gEENS71kwh.jpg) [Kürtőskalács](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K%C3%BCrt%C5%91skal%C3%A1cs), or horn cake, or chimney cake is a traditional food and a must at every fair. The problem is the price as 30 RON is one of the highest and the reason why you don't see any buyers. Those spiraled fried potatoes are not as old as the traditional kürtőskalács, but are just as expensive as the kürtőskalács. 10 RON for a fried potato, that you can buy for a few pennies raw is a ripoff. ![20260913_120923a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpLf79MZcVbP2jyxLM9GbJhHC9iB7bBosA5SpX71B37sK2zQZN5LmCELuFBTJ8meXXy.jpg) ![20260913_120932a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQtWNfQsZQnkqueB7ifHMGHV3uw62EfKAX83UD8sCDzKZQKLUfLdR3EzZ8tSB2teqzc.jpg) These vendors made a bit more effort, at the same and higher price, but not many were interested in buying. ![20260913_120941a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep7v1saMqqvaG7PZJmYrPM2JdBMcYvKLbRgjF7dyA83CcgStBSHqAjgVuTPxfA1Yxvm.jpg) Artisan cheese always works as a magnet, till you see the price tag. However, every once in awhile, it's ok to test a new one. I didn't buy any though. ![20260913_121003a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoGyut5qvY1xwrrDBBxhakTiGd34aynJHyky2jGyw6vtiSfpAWd2UJmi5UbswrghAAS.jpg) ![20260913_121012a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EogPJTW2pY37DvCEKXGZ7aKEnXCySCXBPuoSwA45wKooXzPtimf1f49naKidEa95cnP.jpg) ![20260913_121014a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoK8C5Fzz7XakkxEFPSW7SwRJn9UdMLsL4kGK4WerRuQGA68m829BEV8okY6Q7hvUSf.jpg) This was where the fun began, but only for the eye and the lens of my camera. These sweets looked good, but not healthy at all, so it's better if we move on. ![20260913_121100a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep5n7x1V5WDNwgtaQ6zh7EX4LhjwWiLTjPT8bTG1ZTiofoWg23jtgERPDx4peNmnipg.jpg) ![20260913_121115a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep3erra57SRRXSnAoTH8uhPzbukECxgx6WG13ndyVEtjTZtVL5U8AL5N2cFgH9DXpfA.jpg) And this was where the fun began for the eye, the lens and the for taste buds, but not mine. I live artisan chocolate and would have bought the whole table, but ... well, yes, there's always a but. I'd rather make my own one day. They had sugar free, gluten free chocolate and with sugar as well. The price? Better not ask. ![20260913_121228a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep7v1LiWftqeYFTJRZkUAryaKuyC4JuuJ3MR8W28aKnREQkNNJ6c7NfmSX4ZR7N9q1e.jpg) More sweets, more colorants and chemicals :) ![20260913_121303a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EowJ2Ef3zmDSoZzgRkVMNHziRXH5UG9EZG1eQBytPP1b698crZd7gnEMua1tXWv21Rr.jpg) I love these artisan brandies, but just to look at them as I rarely drink alcohol and when I do, I go for something lighter. These are too strong, but look good and a good present for someone who can appreciate them. ![20260913_121314a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xyZkTRN7koYPw1mqcmq92xoVqhE2bYxSne5Ghq7m5XhtqaV6QqDZYpZnPJVheYe4wvo.jpg) This was where I needed all my willpower, to take a shot and move on. Those mugs were calling my name, but honestly, to buy one more and have 15, and pay 3 times where a normal mug costs ... naah. But loved them a lot. ![20260913_121402a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23ynWT9GoCeEWfWJ86aBJa7YUg1yKLW4R125cJFWtZ4TV9awMhSM3arpZWZMRj1Zr3ZQX.jpg) Wooden items and toys are very popular again and parents who can afford them are making the right choice. Durability, health are just two reasons why you should choose them. Imagine these can be passed down to generations, not like the plastic ones, that break the next day. These can be fixed as well, in case some kids are more inventive and have more energy than planned. ![20260913_121427a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23ywuXxBJu3EhRN8AN1MqcaCJBJZZKdvff5hFTKsj5i29fjF3DciemBPxihBXBFr889ic.jpg) ![20260913_121412a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wMf2Ty6q2gPcegpHPYcnGtX5tTwzePMetW6XaGv7W19cDxhUjao2PP6KDWiiCKMbbLF.jpg) Cuteness at the highest level, what can I say? How can you not love such cutie pies? ![20260913_121433a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23yTgx1p1hthi36Fc6QqXRcd5cFkJQTJVJxCz3mtdptR9DgAqgK4L5QWrNBEgK2iNANyg.jpg) ![20260913_121443a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wX3VAzXT67y4fDnNrVbEHJJ1o7PY3yXuMmuCHHp8KcNQoCuJmWWk1zUMiiaKy8Z57ZU.jpg) They had a lot of amazing candles with traditional, Hungarian motifs and sayings. I love the look, but am not exactly a candle person. ![20260913_121453a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xydfuzvJatb4peULaAUNdMsmX3BVcfXAVWXu3cVB6EHKyq6bvA6KKG9MJPnTqEPM93p.jpg) Mugs and bottles with lovely designs, vases as well, but again, do I need them, or just want them? Look how they have grown. They were very tiny and very delicate when I pulled them out of the mother's pot. Now they are perky teenagers.
![100202226cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWoACR9no1K85t5KfHc1BvWHbPG1NpZNBagD7J4JMnyos/100202226cover.png) *New branch reaching out to meet the bugs*
Let's compare one of these [as a baby in this post](https://hive.blog/hive-140635/@greenthings/updates-first-pot-for-baby-venus-and-binata--k4z) to these, the only pair I have ever raised from babies.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3uGQPYAU657psozQDd2dk4dTASqcg5mJEmhSPyZFn3Z/image.png) *the whole plant just 8 months ago*
They were so delicate when we pulled them out of their mother's pot. And the two of them together. I can't be sure which one was featured in the mentioned post. As I said, these are the only two I've raised from babies, so I know it's one of them.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQR26KAnyaQpVeDuuCjyqwM37kM2xWKR8QhYziYwCvMUj/image.png) *tiny plants are easier to get all branches in focus*
Now look at them. They're getting big - they have outgrown their pots. They are even unrolling their flower chains - you get one bloom per day or so. As soon as one is closing, the other one opens. You will see that later this spring.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3rckYzfiTKStRgdqpP2mKuBtSayM2ojbSiqtzSusDAV/image.png)
That's how you get these little buggers in focus, put a finger behind them. To look at one in person, you would be amazed how quickly your eyes change focus from one branch to the next and you don't even realize you're focusing. This flower cluster is about ready to bloom within the next day or two.
![brokenbinatabranch.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTDN2CtZWFXugCxVAMX5Gn4PYJ7hmeRCqL8RbSpNTmBH/brokenbinatabranch.png)
Re-potting can sometimes remedy the broken branch if it's still connected. Now that I look at it, I believe this is the exact same pot and plant that we saw above as a baby eight months ago.
![new-leaf-forming.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRRejqjDU7mwXdq6SbJVbpQvDbfQoypqZWdu34xEkq5BT/new-leaf-forming.png)
Flowers look different than the leaves do when they are coming out. above we see one stem and four branches unrolling from the second bifurcation. The stem unrolls in two directions (first fork) then the ones that you see above, forking again. Here's another one opening up on the other plant. They're beautiful.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVzv8EnNTPgXi2zAb1DcDyXtU4F8iTZ6HvbhWEERv4x8Z/image.png)
Let me try to get a picture of one of these leaves as an adult.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2xiV6whSiaj2Vueb51LcS3VbXXPXcmiREi3QWQGUMiw/image.png) *spoiler, this picture is post re-pot*
This one is browning a little bit at the tips. #### Re-potting Before we re-pot these, I have A smaller job that I have to take care of beforehand.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf6Eu3wNJLRuTr93izaG8qAnZdT2TfXJnmfH9fffmxtvN/image.png)
So let's get busy. There are at least two baby Droseras That needed a new home. Where should we put them?
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcDV6jaAMiadSbMvoujFJVL6AWH1Bi3xa244qAevGGv58/image.png)
We're going to take the baby Drosera plants that are at the base of this one and move them into our moss garden for now.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNt8CtYVn8a4SKzKZ8uAaLYjxMPajTYCxtpjRtSP7mGA/image.png)
It looks like there were only two baby plants at the base, so now we're ready to move the larger plant, the Benata, to its new pot. We begin to get the pots ready, starting with whole moss and perlite. It looks like one of the pots has a spider living in it. Perlite and moss up to this level. It will compact a little bit later.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYmx8xS8YymZy1KNYiyA671jRjvEWL5gKFVFzfDipaXZo/image.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaibwmQAH6YF4199RZbWsgbBdNTtMKnFjPKLhjwsvCYvv/image.png)
--- We finish getting the pots ready, starting with minced moss. Then we make a thumb hole toward the bottom. If we end up with long roots hanging, they go to the bottom.
![2binata-pots-ready.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQv9QQUUPbtnWhDvGxP4TDfmsdNJrVwL4YTkcEXd6wtea/2binata-pots-ready.png)
We don't want the plants all the way up to the rim because the branches will flap over the edge, and possibly break as we saw above. They need to be held up in the air where they need to be in order to catch bugs. As the plant grows through the summer, we can add extra loss as it gets taller. I want the top edge of the pot to be support for the branches as they grow taller. Now that we have the substrate up to its level and we have a hole to put the plant in. We're going to use long nose pliers to pinch the soil around the root and lift it out and put it in the new pot. Let's see how well the roots took to the first potting...
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTk3EAADDjFsvVC3PMTjH2dkqtgJnKXsRFZUJrhJTVfdB/image.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZtmMZs5g4HNYxBzkFbnm1hM8fPkibgtHps1mRkA1B321/image.png)
--- On the left, we see the pliers gently pinching the 'soil' around the roots. You can see how much of the old 'soil' came up with the plant. On the right, we are seeing the actual roots of the plant. I could have gone with a taller pot. And we'll keep that in mind for the next re-potting depending on the outward volume, we can size the pot better. The roots look more like bark than roots, but these roots will clog up if minerals or chemicals come in contact with them. If that happens no moisture would get up to the top of the plant. Picky little bug munchers. #### Next! This is the one with the broken branch that we are hoping to mend.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcjSCgxyc3eAdbkdLjAJ2VHu2w4Yr7iBRqbWxEoqSPCa/image.png)
This plant was also not very well centered in its old pot and so hopefully it will do better now that's in the center of the new, slightly larger pot.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPtiwLqgNkBK2c7gvXAZQFJrrnjFQ6tK63AZRCML3tA3Y/image.png)
It is a good time to pot these in early springtime as we are experiencing here. They are more resilient because they are trying their hardest to get their leaves out and their flowers up in the air to start eating and reproducing.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyN5DdZjoTm2sbt8otU6qphprB7A7dV56nAqw986f2i1/image.png)
And finally the finished product we have two plants re-potted and the babies are growing in the Moss Garden.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb53V8fheLyWokXfc8hZ9zuUoRo5GrsodwDF6B6cPKfpn/image.png)
You can even see the broken branches now properly supported. It might green up again in the future, hopefully anyways. --- Thanks for reading, following and commenting on my posts. Your support is appreciated.

说起来O哥也已经有十几年的驾龄了（好像有十三四年了？），如果按驾龄算，那大概也算得上是老司机啦。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRtCud2TB4BSp7BEW278RwGsYEwpsv3neA7tuzWMAY8Dx/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

其实O哥是个很懒的人，一直懒得考驾照，哪怕后来有娃了，为了方便出行买车了，我还是懒得学，合计家里有媳妇这个司机就可以啦。

后来发生了一些事情，不得不学开车，不得不去考驾照，就这样，O哥被赶鸭子上架，成了一名驾驶员。

O哥成为驾驶员之后，也是很抵触开车的，毕竟啊，开车多累人。我记得有一年开车去大连玩，几天内大概开了2000左右公里，回来累得好多天都直不起来腰呢。

所以无论去哪里，能不开车的情况下，我绝不开车，一般都会选择公共交通出行（公交、地铁、高铁、共享单车），实在着急的时候，就叫网约车。

就算是回老家，除非是全家人一起回，大包小裹拿很多东西的情况下，我选择开车，若是自己一个人往返，我都选择高铁。

其实乘坐高铁回老家无论是时间上还是花销上一点也不省啊，金钱就不说了，时间上打车到高铁站，高铁站等车，高铁运行，打车回家，没个三四个小时到不了，而我开车，最快一个半小时就可以到呢。

但是高铁我省事呀，好吧，其实是我懒。

所以，开车近十年，我才开了几千公里（出去玩几趟+回老家），被朋友们嘲笑得不得了，说我家的车就是浪费，哈哈。


![b5f4934ee0feef45f20e287723e21836.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCTsfyHv5y1PafDCHByAP39R5BSQ4L47t2tk3fkBwUf9/b5f4934ee0feef45f20e287723e21836.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)


什么时候开车变得多了起来呢？大概是从儿子读初中开始吧，他上小学时学校就在家门口，步行上学就可以。但是初中离家三四公里，总不能还步行呀。

于是“老司机”开始开始接送娃的日子，我还记得第一天送娃，我被俩排车挤到马路中间骑线前行，然后被旁边的大客车刮了我的后视镜，卡卡卡都刮掉漆了。

儿子气够呛，让我追上大客车，让它赔钱，可是我心虚得不得了，我没开在正常的车道里，人家不找我赔钱就不错啦。

反正开始天天开车送娃的那段时间，真的是状况频发，好在事情都不大，最严重的一次是想变道插队，被后边专业碰瓷的车顶了上来，基本上双方车辆都没啥大损害，但被人家讹了300大洋，每次想起这事我都意难平呀。

就这样接送了初中三年，我从“驾龄”上的老司机，变成驾驶经验上的老司机，慢慢地也开始飙车啦。

尤其是儿子上了高中以后，路程翻倍，上学放学时间又紧，超级考验车技，现在每趟行程，我都要比高德预估的快好多。

原本我还为我的车技以及飙车速度沾沾自喜，结果这几天大家在群里聊接送孩子的话题，发现真的老多飙车大神的啦。

比如我早晨送娃六公里，最快的时候也要十一二分钟，结果人家20公里，也才15分钟，没法比呀没法比。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRH72NM8er6igGKZw9W4y8Q8qaw4jhJ4do3se4hAxmfka/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

看到这些信息后，我突然发现，自己有时候也太在意和追求速度了，这样其实是不对的，安全才是第一位呢。

所以我决定以后接送娃不能飙车了，虽然不能慢慢开，但也要稳稳开。毕竟我飙车使大劲就能省出三两分钟，而儿子每次回家闲聊都能聊上半个多小时（甚至更多），这三两分钟，哪里省不出来呢？

By now I think that you know the male Malachite Sunbird (Nectarinia famosa), and his iridescent colors was on show (5 shots). Then I have a cute little lady sipping some nectar from a Salvia plant's flowers (5 shots).

Some of the birds know me, especially the sunbirds, oh, and also the Pied Crows, as they all have good memories. And so, they don't get nervous when I come close as they know that I will not harm them. Birds are very intelligent, and when I go out to get them on camera, I always wear my black beret (cap). In fact, the little Laughing Doves and the Cape Robin-chats know our car, and as soon as we come back from anywhere then they rush in to grab some nuts that the wife leaves especially for them on the floor behind the car before I can shut the door.  

What we normally do, is we let them eat while we sit in the car and wait for them to eat their fill, as then they pop over to the water bowls for drinks then we can alight from the car and enter the house. Other times, when we pull the car out of the garage, the auto door has to remain open when they fly in to eat, as we then sit and wait for them to finish before we can close the door and be on our way. Just some birdy fun. Lol. 


![042.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23x1DQ37j8tBJrYCgsXJefU9WTPpvUzQvKqEeqKBbGsC1mXtJqhzKuLpRzmBMkQ181rCb.JPG)

![058.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xehVHsTF6JggV7v9FE9GpERJgLHvZeZui97TAjuQ23dp43PMxFBCsrygzu9oAdH3nm6.JPG)

![054.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uQpVa2wJf7YpTxJfzm8uq9gPbJ6UA16wgCfuzYUuM5Gqbwz5qceSFQq7yhR7fNfkRr1.JPG)

![059.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wgPhsv4w4ggxDvV8LRVs8CGQixX9TgoaJXXswFniNnHuaEkhASchQJ9Fh7H1pVZ16FN.JPG)

**This dainty lady below is a Southern Double-collared Sunbird (Cinnyris chalybeus).**

Those Salvia flower stems are very thin and flexible, and the bigger sunbirds cannot sit on them. Even the male of these Southern Double-collared sunbirds cannot sit on the stems, and he hovers when he takes nectar from the tubular flowers. 
![072.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep1WsuQ6hcZNBvPkp2z95VhpsTPDbfwBVpJFZJBGRzDdfpK5aT44nNpCuVHkHk9Dbbe.JPG)

![083.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wgPrYBGQ9nbx12hMoeU6MHcon2QDpz5P4VuN3SpeeEqZ2j1sEAyqU5huTGTWDcuFyGa.JPG)

![085.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoCghN21nNzxNn5KK8ctSStdGPNr3jKwW623ZrKqkSxGGZhg7ufECVZdxMWQ3Sku2WF.JPG)

![088.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eou8CnUMACQGZnKajGuAjN314pskNtsTmK1xgXt92Dj9nQHtVqiZc7b2eiPBUsCqxGJ.JPG)

![098.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EogLqJ17vBPwME92itmighvt3Xk9tfAR6AuHSTFBZ2HhWwePC5M7eYkParFaJdgke3g.JPG)

I said up top, that I do know where to find the birds, and after eight years down here one would expect me to know, as every time that we enter into nature, and that's quite often, I pay much attention to the surroundings. It has become a habit over the years, and we even know what kind of birds will appear in what season. There used to be a large flock of Peafowls also at this spot, but they have all disappeared. My wife used to feed them by hand, and sadly they are no more. 

There is another sad thing that I need to tell you. Many of our birds have become endangered, and the number of threatened bird species now stands at 33 in the Western Cape province alone. I read an article that contains all the numbers, and it wasn't pleasant to read how nature is being destroyed. 
The article appeared in the Daily Maverick newspaper, 09-15 October 2026, titled "Cape Nature's 2026 report card". The author of the article is Don Pinnock. So, you are welcome to google it to see what's going on for yourself. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story. 

Photos by Zac Smith. No AI and no Photoshop. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time. Shalom!

話說，九月是非常忙的一個月。我們家的老佛爺，我家小拉拉和我阿姨，她們三個都是九月生日的，也都是在中秋季節這段時間。所以，每逢到了中秋，你們拉叔我卡是需要慶祝好幾次的，

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9UWffX74eEiP2BTxjb9LX48C8P5VSo6JRpDnu9h6LDR/1792481849370.jpg)
小拉拉去了補習班，我們三人到商場去買一些日用品。然後順路進去金加利吃個晚飯。我點了個公仔面吃，算是簡單的一餐。


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYszQ4sQPY2oUophpX3FgfTBeWBAT5aKqFcLqmSNKoH8e/1792481849469.jpg)
可是，單點個方便麵又好像不太夠。於是，找到其實套餐也不錯的。因為多加幾塊錢就可以多一條熱狗。這東西如果單點的話可是要整十塊錢呢。於是，我的套餐立馬又在升級，多追加了個絲襪奶茶。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKjoqT26ex7JdgjMxpGRbyzgoG6PsowMtBn9ojpg6PoM/1792481849555.jpg)
母老虎可沒上當，她不點套餐。她要的是肉碎炒茄子，鍋氣非常到位。她再另外單點個奶茶。我算了一下，其實這個算盤打得挺響的，價格的確跟我的套餐比起來便宜幾毛錢，不過這就少吃很多了。結果，一埋單，又是整百塊錢。這當然還包含我家大小姐點的白醬意大利面，沒有拍到照片我就不加註釋了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRVjEeGG6ZTbbsCczRDvbMU5T21xpuFNtZ2FVqpbZbUu4/1792481849649.jpg)

隔天我們到教堂去讓母老虎收拾和整理一哈她的詩歌。每逢週末我們都會到教堂去唱歌，而週日也會回去收拾詩歌，方便下個禮拜用。我們一般都會到教堂附近的印度店去吃早餐。我點了的是鳥巢飛餅。其實就是印度飛餅家兩個蛋嘛。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmqsGkGLcbHMJ94YQQotKfan9yQ2CqbEdRrVVsybNUUj/1792481849733.jpg)
收拾完詩歌，我們立馬就開車趕路回去老家找老媽了。回到家其實已經時間不早，於是我們又帶著老媽開車出去吃個客家餐廳。我是沒敢點什麼，只拿了個空碗。結果，大家的菜都不肯吃，於是我就點了一碟麵，什麼都沒，連調味都沒的，於是就替大家更下了他們不要的。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmarYuFxPMexXix7xdbqYEzGZK1vVbhZ3u4foieEJ2wxYG/1792481912784.jpg)
小拉拉和大小姐各自點了咕嚕肉套餐，母老虎的是雞酒麵線，老媽的是豬腳醋。他們把1不喜歡的菜，都扔了過來給我。我的最新生存之道就是，我什麼都不點，就等著吃他們剩下的。一方面省錢，第二方面不浪費食物。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqhaZ8Y9JHaEofoJNVLHynifuCEBc8BW3Xj1SSsGczee/1792481912872.jpg)
當天晚上，我們和老媽吃了個晚飯，慶祝了生日後，我們馬上開車又趕路回吉隆坡，因為隔天是你們拉叔我回去找陳小姐牙醫師了。這次，也一樣沒有辦法為我治療。不知是我太緊張，還是所有菇涼恐懼症，每次到醫院量血壓的時候都爆表的。護士，我可以摸摸你的小心臟嗎？啊不，我是說你可以摸摸我的小心臟嗎？

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVaZ6zNmLdBuk8YGXZj5qbSPPnAkffQB7fUEc43xmE9oA/1792481912984.jpg)
雖然是請了假，不過早上見牙醫後，反正我也是閒著，於是就搭單軌回去公司，準備去顧客哪裡坐坐吃個午飯打打屁。這是才發現，我們的單軌官方終於肯把這風扇給洗一下了。現在大風了很多，也不會突然有一大片灰塵吹過來我頭頂了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQutx2jqMkB7hZhHbfVu2EwQ8HA6VpUCgHky45XtDLsT/1792481913075.jpg)
我們顧客可是對拉叔不錯了，雖然我們給的福利不多，但是他們還是繼續支持著用我們的保險。可能是總經理跟我差不多年紀，大家還算聊得來，對於業績分配還是很賞臉我們的。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFSTFhuz4x8nzECRsLnpGZD449ZRoRvwmSfzM2Sy4MVS/1792481913134.jpg)
這回程時決定出來走走，省個地鐵站費用，還可以順便當散步運動。不走還好，已經過這裡，看到了原來hard rock在搞特點午餐套餐。買三個人分，送一個人。感覺超值啦。可惜，只做星期一到星期五。

<center>![PXL_20260710_165348521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vPALT86992ocVGg3p4m1UUpvo1u6ccaZWG8VbaMD8emSUfe9QebEtVN9DG29LRdQUfr.jpg)</center>

---------------------

It's not happening as quickly as I would like, but slowly my wife and I are filling in the map we have of the United States.  This year was actually pretty special for us as we got to add five of the little wooden pieces to the map that was given to us for Christmas a few years ago.  Sadly, there are still a lot of open spaces to fill, but I am confident that given time, we can change that. While I wouldn't put any one state above the others among the new five we visited together this year, Wisconsin is a little special mostly for the fact that we hauled our travel trailer there and camped this summer. 

I had been to Wisconsin a few times myself through the years, but as I mentioned, this was the first time we had visited the state together.  The rules of our map are that we can't add pieces if we haven't been there together, and we also can't add pieces if we are just in the state for a layover or something like that.  For example, a year or two ago when we went to Vermont, we had a connecting flight in Atlanta.  We never left the airport, so Georgia still remains unfilled on our map.

<center>![PXL_20260711_154450752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/242NcpLibjKahq1qPKnFvF46dUfbX3qEQRwhuDQk2bBup3HttedVouDkvmte2qRZnqsvC.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

Wisconsin is a pretty cool state as far as states go.  I mean, cheese, beer, and bratwurst, what can you really hate about that?  Plus, the state has a lot of natural wonders that make it quite impressive.  Maybe not as many as Michigan, but still enough that it is worth going there.  We just got back from Texas with @mrsbozz's sister and brother in law, and we have already started throwing out ideas for our next city to visit.  Milwaukee was in the list of places to check out some day.  During our trip, we stuck mostly to the northern parts of the state, where the western shoreline of Lake Superior is absolutely amazing.


<center>![PXL_20260709_161910331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23yTUjrZCeJjccRoUrGwbP8rAHasxdy94aoCiofTLMtzVxRypq7B2Xo47buHgArwB99y3.jpg)</center>

----------------------------------

If you ever get the chance to visit there, I highly recommend it!  The water is so pristine, the fish is amazing, and it is just a magical place.  I definitely want to take the time to explore more of the state if I ever get the chance.  I've heard the Dells area is pretty cool if not a bit touristy, and kind of commercialized now. 

Believe it or not, this is actually the penultimate episode of my #threetunetuesday series that is covering the fifty states of the United States.  We started all the way back at A with Alabama, and now here we are just about a year later rolling our way into Wisconsin before we move along to Wyoming to wrap things up.  In case you forgot, each of the three songs I am going to share needs to have Wisconsin in the title or lyrics.  It might have been easier if I could just reference a town in the state, but nope, I decided it needs to be the actual state name.

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/5QRicsY5hOk?si=fEpFzmL3xXS21Uwn" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

----------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5QRicsY5hOk&list=RD5QRicsY5hOk&start_radio=1)

----------------------------

Believe it or not, Wisconsin was a lot harder than I thought it was going to be for this post.  Somehow in the back of my head, I thought there were a lot more songs that either mentioned Wisconsin or had it in the title, but I was very wrong.  I honestly struggled a bit to find the songs that I am going to share today.  Nancy Griffith is actually a pretty cool artist and she can write some really insightful lyrics.  I can appreciate that not everyone might like her style, or the twang of her voice, but if you don't like this song, at least dig into some of her slower stuff.  "Pearl's Eye View" is a new song for me, but it does have a reference to Wisconsin in it, so I figured I would share it here.  Plus, I am pretty sure I have never shared any of Griffith's songs before, so I thought that might be a cool thing to do as well.

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7T0nYP6ukSg?si=qWPxL_OAQEYAK5FH" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

--------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7T0nYP6ukSg&list=RD7T0nYP6ukSg&start_radio=1)

-------------------------

I've mentioned it before, but I always seem to get Tom Waits and John Waite messed up.  I know anyone who knows both artists probably thinks I am an idiot for that, but that's just how it is.  Sorry.  Anyway, in a pretty big departure from the kind of music you might be used to him playing, "Diamonds on My Windshield" is a kind of jazzy tune that is spoken more than it is sang.  Kind of in the vein of George Thorogoood or something like that.  If you listen closely, it does mention Wisconsin, so it fits the bill for this post.  Oddly enough, it seems like so far both of the videos I have shared today were from about 11 years ago.  I can promise you the last one will be a bit newer.

Hola!! Buenas Noches familia #diyhub, amantes de los trabajos manuales y artesanías, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) a Alastor 'El demonio de la Radio', protagonista de la serie animada Hazbin Hotel. The inspiration for this project came from Pinterest ideas, where I discovered Alastor, also known as 'The Radio Demon.' He is a sinner demon and one of the powerful Overlords of Hell, and one of the main protagonists of the animated musical series Hazbin Hotel. He stands out from many of the most chaotic inhabitants of the Underworld due to his affable and well-kept personality. I really liked this character because of his demonic appearance. Now I'm sharing with you the design I made with foam clay for the community. I know it's not much, but it's my way of expressing myself through art.
La inspiración para este proyecto llegó gracias a las ideas de Pinterest, donde descubrí a Alastor, también conocido como 'El Demonio de la Radio'. Es un demonio pecador y uno de los Overlords poderosos del Infierno, de los principales protagonistas de la serie animada musical Hazbin Hotel. Se distingue de muchos de los habitantes más caóticos del Ultramundo por su personalidad afable y bien cuidada. Este personaje me gustó mucho por su apariencia demoníaca. Ahora les comparto el diseño que hice en foami clay para la comunidad. Sé que no es mucho, pero es mi manera de expresarme mediante el arte. Link externo
In the following I will show you step by step the realization of my work. To begin with, I will mention all the materials used:
A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rojo / Red foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Beige / Beige foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Amarillo / Yellow foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Carmelita / Carmelite foam clay
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

    • STEP / PASO 1

    In the initial phase, I begin by taking a portion of beige clay to make the body of the cartoon character. Then, with my hands I mold it into a ball shape, giving it a curious finish.
    En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en color beige para realizar el cuerpo del animado. Luego, con las manos moldeó en forma de bola, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

    STEP / PASO 2

    Next, I develop the body parts of the demon: his head, his sclerotic eyes, his yellow-toned smile, his red coat, his shiny shirt with a black cross on the chest, black pants, a knotted bow tie, the arms, gloves, and legs with matching shoes, always giving my best.
    Seguidamente, desarrollo las piezas del cuerpo en el demonio, su cabeza, sus ojos escleróticos, su sonrisa de tono amarillo, su abrigo rojo, su camiseta brillante con una cruz negra en el pecho, pantalon negro, una pajarita anudada, los brazos, guantes y piernas con zapatos a juego, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

    STEP / PASO 3

    Lastly, we make the final touches on the eyes, his devilish teeth, his hair, and the fine cane with a sensitive vintage-style microphone, in shades of brown, red, yellow, black, and white. This design is a bit more complex, since the parts are smaller when molding.
    Ya por último, realizamos los retoques finales en los ojos, sus dientes diabólicos, su cabello y el fino bastón con un micrófono sensible de estilo vintage, en tonalidades de carmelita, rojo, amarillo, negro y blanco. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear.

    Final result / Resultado final

身為一名有信仰的人，尤其是基督教/天主教這種經常會以天使與魔鬼來區分好與壞的辨別性。時代一直不停的演變，以現在資訊發達的時代科技本身就是天使與魔鬼了，宗教本身也被資訊給統治了。試問先進還有幾個現代人懂得翻聖經本子呢？真的，那天我們教堂停電，吩咐大家打開實體聖經時，我四處觀望也只有三幾個老人拿起聖經來翻，而且速度之快，感覺比其他年輕人打開手機，打經文章節去搜更快。

大家好鴨。我是拉叔，是一名讀了初級編程學位的程序猿。但是，畢業後，盡是幹一些和電腦編程沒什麼相關的工作。我當過鐵廠品鑑工，當過製衣廠的搬運工，也在星巴巴那式樣的咖啡館泡過咖啡，現在還在保險公司裡頭當個小經理。那好了，介紹完畢，跟今天的題目有什麼關係呢？

我是想說，這幾年來特別是AI盛行，你們拉叔我發現不少作死的人開始用AI幹壞事，而由於這樣的事件頻繁發生，導致出現了兩個極端的說法。一方面認為AI是個人天才，什麼鬼都可以用AI解決，甚至娶老婆都直接買個人形娃娃，把個微型電腦塞進娃娃體內，就可以當老婆了。還說，這樣的老婆，又聽話，成本又低。我也看過一些不能用“搜”出來的禁片，這些被訪問的AI娃娃的“老公”都已經把這些娃娃當成“人體”來用……怎麼用啊？冷冰冰的？不怕，使用前先“植入”保暖袋加熱……OMGY（歐買觀音……我們華人還是用回中國神好了，歐買嘎還是留給老外了）

咦？剛才不是說，這些人形娃娃有AI加持，就會是好像天使一般的老婆嗎？為什麼後面讀起來越來越醜惡了？沒錯。天使與魔鬼，人性驅使也。如果前面有個真的女人，不是你老婆，但卻對你千依百順，躺著任由你蹂躪，讓我再次提醒你，前面的是一個活生生的人，你說她是天使還是魔鬼。你，對她幹這種事的，是天使還是魔鬼？

拉叔怎麼越說越像開車了？我只能用這個最人性化的方法來形容。AI是AI，因為它只是一組沒有靈魂的“思想”。它有它的獨特邏輯運行模式，還可以是千變萬化。它，對於我們人類的指令，也一樣可以千變萬化的給出不一樣的答案，但那絕對不是「靈魂」。AI給出個什麼答案，是要看背後給予指令的人，用的是什麼心機。

某朋友今天給了我很大的啟發。他是拉叔的好朋友，平時無所不談。有時候，我們會聊一些很深的人性哲學。有時，我們又會傻到說一些不設邊際的傻碧假設。今天也一樣，我問友人怎麼，今天有沒找個適合的女孩子撞一下。友人看我這麼說，估計也是立馬還手也來刺激我一下說，比不上我，要也是拉叔先給個女人撞。

於是，我的靈機一閃🤣找了我家谷歌AI，我叫“她”，朱咪咪，讓她替我繪圖，然後發給友人🤣我是故意用比較純真的方法去給指令的，於是就有了以下的畫面🤣

友人看了，應該有點不服氣。然後立馬補充說，讓她用妹妹撞我……於是，我又找朱咪咪幫上忙，讓個小妹妹把我給撞上了🤣🤣🤣

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaE4TZRHfJa9DsL7H1ixrUi8P3Ai5fZsMFTmgAUrCRic/1792567327056.jpg)

於是，友人又繼續補充，讓她的pussy 撞我。這個我當然知道谷歌的使用規範不能涉及黃色內容，於是我又用pussy cat來躲一下🤣🤣🤣

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVTvsKSgUD541NTMzExdg1LkgnD7crpf19J9eH3LWDpF/1792567327096.jpg)

後來友人直接說，讓我不要給他裝純情，說我知道用什麼撞的🤣今天開車到此為止，都出車禍了，還開什麼開。我就是要總結一下，AI絕對不是天使，但人永遠是魔鬼。如果我們給AI的指令稍微有點魔性，你猜今天這些畫面還能不擦邊走線嗎？

![IMG_2914.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/23wX1FX78fqX6B2jguMDR2ihTSSsBBzM7ASCknP9RLggQCqGbrvtAiiqGGtp5f9cgExvU.JPG) [Click here to read this post in **English**](#english) Hola querido hiver. ¿Quién puede negar la belleza de Marilyn Monroe? Su fotogenia está fuera de toda duda, con su mezcla de inocencia, vulnerabilidad y erotismo. Sabemos que detrás de esa sonrisa perfecta había mucho sufrimiento, así que verla tan radiante y relajada como aparece en las fotografías de esta exposición es un regalo. ![IMG_2917.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EprUbW9mPUaVxt6RgBAJBLD34bsnwNAMX1kYJ9n7jJVb3SEZeGf9gkqE3ok32e7iNvS.JPG) ![IMG_2918.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoEswvF9RUYUydrxKFWfCD6pxrnyHKaobbQ14rdhr7u27Lp7yq7uhq36RweKY968scS.JPG) ![IMG_2919.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoptPxsQduzuvdFEyQ6WfdoFipGWj7s9rHiMvR1aYeStMsX2Cet4YfRtPrdYRrqpfGn.JPG) ![IMG_2922.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eo6Lw6gmHZ2ff8q2jHKNfYuf9T25rBaQqKGbyQLHTxbght642FTBpLLymTZyiQwJvqv.JPG) En 2026 se cumple el centenario del nacimiento de Marilyn Monroe y por eso en el Centro de Historias de Zaragoza organizaron esta exposición que refleja los años dorados de la actriz americana. Las fotografías que vemos fueron realizadas a lo largo de cinco años, entre 1953 y 1957, por el fotógrafo Milton H. Greene. ![IMG_2924.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoeGRCA19weu6eM1ebWGsoQJa3P5VtyUseqeAx6LpoTq1hCWFnPqQeaVg5HNT3PHnJN.JPG) ![IMG_2926.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoeHMgxizHJXPvKhJC5K8Va1s7uf6kpBsgAc9wnV6cEVecveUL2raJ5FpKbuh8naFh7.JPG) ![IMG_2928.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoEsNG5aPTskbCP97QYctxEiRc6q8bB6RAWoLcsRzc37XcQJrcmMNEoPrtzQhPpWigM.JPG) ![IMG_2931.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoAbE6uKNXLz2WnaWUYQpdwVLQnBPnUzaY8yfhUgiiMb5dKy3cYdCj9hVamfgGpDrQh.JPG) En la exposición las imágenes se organizan por sesiones fotográficas, algunas fueron preparadas y otras espontáneas o durante momentos de su vida cotidiana e íntima. Seguro que reconocerás más de una. Sin ir más lejos, la foto sobre estas líneas en la que Marilyn aparece vestida de bailarina y tocándose la barbilla con un dedo fue elegida como una de las tres mejores fotografías del siglo XX por la revista TIME en 1999. ![IMG_2932.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eoc7551SeoCNoBAh45yrgFqTEk8qp1ntjqGmzFUcf9MtngLTs9prM5L25BHZjRh4y9G.JPG) ![IMG_2933.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EogQnxNqyu8FpUa22UuJY3gB1K6pL1Vd5KCVxboBbnif4JbseZfwpDsmTxDp9hyx2Lk.JPG) ![IMG_2934.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Ep5pfJ8b4MdMiDb5gmGG6Gk5Yz842dDDc7yKfCDRwnW6RvdsAmtZ1ejeZcAE9NM3Nce.JPG) ![IMG_2935.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoeJGSgDVnjDjuP3BAwg9tUfQr2ge323tR9XnDscvAz2LUbWpmsuvk8GmVtqL1f5mZs.JPG) La primera parte de la exposición nos muestra esas sesiones que buscaban resaltar la belleza de Mairlyn. A veces con un sencillo fondo neutro, otras dándole protagonismo a algún objeto que le acompañaba. Hay sesiones que tardaron hasta veinte años en ver la luz porque permanecieron en en una carpeta privada del fotógrafo. ![IMG_2937.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoEsvnyJBF312mPkcmT2vtXrNT6CuBRztdoW2iDS5KibTuZYb6J1Mng9c4HcDFX6pji.JPG) ![IMG_2938.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EokfTAsGHPXuyWgSx1kteFdQgDCV6gxpiGLCEVNDtFJNcheywkXqL62WpGNriA5nNxf.JPG) ![IMG_2939.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpLiUdk5Vq3pPHehWwHPVC6NM9NYnb7K5CY6mET7YCQHaegNLry1Azisy8AwZAvBHif.JPG) ![IMG_2940.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpVEy9iQMzuUaFNSigQpNALC4b7NLnM6HRKqN89TukqAp1W3xRiP1NxX1apgBCyXaRK.JPG) El folleto informativo de la exposición, del que he obtenido los datos que comparto, nos dice que Greene realizó más de 5000 fotografías de la actriz. Su relación traspasó lo profesional y tanto él como su esposa Amy compartieron con ella numerosas jornadas de rodajes, celebraciones y vacaciones personales. ![IMG_2941.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoeFpMADffsWdagsmpqHWKkBz3ifm9R9eS4Divhq5wVLsJmKGH66tpChr6LWGRZ1JRX.JPG) ![IMG_2943.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/Eo8VG2HYr5XNxzzKX7YgYJj5Gip71GKLgTPUmUXC5nw4iUwUzkyQcher8F2sE2PcuBP.JPG) ![IMG_2944.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EoyTJ5ZdzTNQaFFGE6jbzzzT7ytv6bJDq59hYngK9fHJaNNmLnvLmPPiVyY2V8xkrdb.JPG) ![IMG_2945.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpA5wwRWAeyy4mTEd2ZGrjFJNWnTL4BoT9iLGqv49vcBrkw1VpKQ8dF99DCoPcA88hX.JPG) Gracias a ellas vemos a una Marilyn que se muestra vulnerable y natural porque así era en esos momentos. Podemos adentrarnos en su boda con el dramaturgo Arthur Miller y hasta *meternos en la cama* con ella. ![IMG_2946.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palomap3/EpnFjACSjAMqgwaaYPLL6RxAQnDuph21Qa9uWB9rMNU5mVnSy3Akhy7d4JUTvpwB7Sg.JPG) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSGKadeBVGnYPA5E7UCqq4uF53DoXuniAxMXfaK9GM9tV/1b0668f9_5558_4fcf_9cfc_31c1373beb9a_1_201_a.jpeg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkyng7CG6rAm9rixqYfMWHuK5J1Ar6oNfKFt8BhiWpfP/0ba2b2dd_fc09_4790_9d45_a3c0002fac85_1_201_a.jpeg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgR9Qz4aMViyMEKxCewqKMYpiUMVoNE4QtRjgRifLhFr/8b78977d_f0be_49eb_89be_088d1305fe37_1_201_a.jpeg) Milton H. Greene retrató a grandes iconos del cine de Hollywood desde Elizabeth Taylor o Marlene Dietrich hasta Grace Kelly o Audrey Hepburn, pasando por Cary Grant o Frank Sinatra, pero con ninguno de ellos entabló la amistad que le unió a Marilyn y que dio como resultado estas maravillosas instantáneas. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcg2ebjzTRnMrJDnti6tUUF66UY7EGrCo31ctGWL8tf4X/5ebc2fd6_2f83_4e69_bfc4_86f4f841abde_1_201_a.jpeg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPPmyRz2qnCXVFWqxRcvaLhrKcaiqTPtAoBWhYDYKJvb/4ee2013a_375d_4913_aff5_68c4934ea423_1_201_a.jpeg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjUygaghCz6mAcAVFsmygQM3UhJ26Gn3HsCe7iPs9ADM/29612e44_ff96_48d7_9cb6_f09d8a3705f0_1_201_a.jpeg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWHcvuFsDfrpn23Axir4PTCt9WHHG26FQFW9UPUwTkLW/f14462e1_a3d3_4b91_b207_6835ca588ba7_1_201_a.jpeg) En la última parte de la exposición encontramos fotografías realizadas por el fotoperiodista Allan Grant, tomadas para acompañar a la entrevista que la revista LIFE publicó dos días antes de la muerte de la actriz, que fue el 4 de agosto de 1962, a los 36 años. Estuvieron más de seis décadas sin localizar. También podemos ver un documental sobre esa misma jornada, un ejemplar original de ese número de la revista LIFE y una serigrafía del artista pop James Francis Gill. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdg4U9KnJfFGRkDWBiMcsqW1EkFRKdUvXbjnNYgxj4MuW/4c5ee322_31e9_492b_9e67_7d05111cad11_1_201_a.jpeg) Hasta la próxima publicación.  --- 


### Hello my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another amazingly amazing Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying an awesome day with your family and friends. Now, if you are one of those undefeated souls who are actively engaging in this Web3 card-based strategy game, then I hope you are actively playing in this ongoing ranked season as well. If you look closely at the season timer, there are still 11 days and 2 hours left before this season ends, so the clock is ticking fast, and it is time to give our best in the remaining battles. Whether you are playing to reach a particular league tier or for a glorious seat on the top Champion leaderboard, I hope you reach there quicker this time.

 --- 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHndxVw1nQpWQjyJLw2qC36foKCxVjkfa34kCxDER5oy/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_5.07.03_pm.png)


 --- 


Now, talking about me, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league with 3,360 trophies, and my next target is to reach 4,000 trophies. There are still several days left in this season, so I will keep pushing forward and try my best to reach that goal. Let's see how far I can go this time! Moving on to the weekly raffle, I currently have 9 entries, and there are still 6 days and 1 hour left before the raffle ends. My target is to reach somewhere between 54 and 57 entries this time. Last week, I managed to collect 60 entries, but unfortunately, I did not receive any rewards. That was a little disappointing, but we all know how raffles work, so I will keep collecting entries and hope for better luck this week.

 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-10-20 at 9.18.41 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23tGXnDoZVGppgWbCZuTsB6BhtbbuQC7MhVbHJst6njrJ28nEJ9iKSztqc2c79BfPYRGd.png)


 --- 


Now, talking about my daily activity, today marks my 157th consecutive streak day in the daily wheel. I received 150 Sparks along with another 38 bonus Sparks, which brings my total Sparks balance to 22,935. Keeping this streak alive feels great, and I will continue playing and collecting rewards as long as possible. Every little reward counts, especially when we are trying to make steady progress in the game.


 --- 




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJ9ZP3udpLACP4yDUPtCaUKfmKqnhC8temoPRMgkHjUT/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.38.28_pm.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ9Chhv45uPE3XK6JVgV9JYqHa7gzL5AnYRp2ktGgWmyL/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.39.38_pm.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbindMNH4k7KRP6v5vEsUCqHjWYLMzkDLMmyodDJyxea/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.41.24_pm.png)


 --- 


I also opened 9 Foundation packs earned from the last three days of Frontier mission rewards. This time, the results were absolutely exciting! I got 2 Legendary cards, 1 Epic Gold Foil card, 2 more Epic cards, and 11 Rare cards, including 3 Archons. On top of that, I also received 1 Common Gold Foil card, while the remaining cards were regular Foil Commons. Getting two Legendary cards in a single opening is definitely a nice surprise, and this batch of packs has given me plenty of reasons to feel happy about the rewards. Let's hope the next opening brings even more good cards!

 --- 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYi6qqFcSG7drtwRfWBcHTHYzUfLPDtxhuSRwfBFtPFtu/image.png)


 --- 


### Kaori Matsune

Now moving on to today's featured monster, let us take a closer look at another interesting monster from the newest Reward card set. As you have already seen in the title above, today we will be discussing Kaori Matsune, a Magic attacker with the Snipe ability. So, if you are interested in knowing more about this Neutral monster and its abilities, then let's take a deep dive without any further ado.

Kaori Matsune is a monster-type card that was first seen in the game with the launch of the latest Reward edition card set. This monster belongs to the Drakoshan bloodline and comes as a Legendary card. It costs only 5 Mana, so you can use it when playing low to medium mana limit matches. It uses Magic to attack its opponents. For a 5 mana card, its Mana cost is quite reasonable, especially when we consider its decent Speed, good Magic attack, and useful abilities. At its maximum level, this monster possesses 3 abilities, making it an interesting choice for players who want to target enemy support units and reduce the effectiveness of opposing Magic attackers. As a Legendary card, you will need 11 CC cards to upgrade Kaori Matsune to its maximum level. Let's now take a look at its stats and abilities at different league levels.

 --- 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQv2Rd6u5xdH2z2G7nJYwS2jkzT7EzNJqzTMGe41jMuFE/screenshot_2026_10_20_at_1.56.53_pm.png)

 --- 



### BRONZE

At Level 1, Kaori Matsune possesses 2 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 4 Health, along with the Snipe ability. Even at its starting level, it has a useful way to target enemies hiding behind the first position.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf7dYgdCRV7r8YudToyd1JKu45zxzfpUKPwPASg69PsZm/image.png)


`SNIPE` – Magic and Ranged units target the first non-Melee enemy unit behind the first position.

### SILVER

At Level 2, Kaori Matsune possesses 2 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 4 Health and also gets a new ability.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVpQCa7muaKDgGdoGjfaebSgwH3mDidEm82kGeEdRP6m6/image.png)


`SILENCE` – Reduces the Magic attack of all enemy units by 1.

### GOLD

At Level 3, Kaori Matsune possesses 3 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 5 Health. Its Magic attack increases to 3, while its Health also improves. This makes it a more powerful attacker without increasing its Mana cost.

### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

At Level 4, Kaori Matsune possesses 3 Magic attack, 3 Speed, and 6 Health. At its maximum level, this monster gains another defensive ability that helps protect it from certain negative effects.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzaBxR5ZbhGwF4AXseNVXyetpLZGSsKmqpEvGVXN29Lh/image.png)


`IMMUNITY` – Provides immunity to Magic debuffs and Cripple.

### My Opinion About the Monster

In my opinion, Kaori Matsune is a very useful Magic attacker because it combines a useful attack, decent Speed, and a good Health pool for only 5 Mana. When we are building a team, Mana cost is always something we need to consider carefully. We cannot simply fill our lineup with expensive monsters and expect everything to work perfectly. That is why I like monsters that offer a good balance between their cost and the abilities they bring to battle, and Kaori Matsune certainly looks like one worth considering. Now, the first thing I like about this monster is its Snipe ability. With this ability, it can target the first non-Melee enemy unit behind that position. This can be very useful when the opponent has placed important support monsters, ranged attackers, or Magic attackers in the backline. The Silence ability is another amazing feature and a strong counter to Magic-based teams. It reduces the Magic attack of all enemy units by 1, which can make a significant difference when the opponent depends heavily on Magic damage. Instead of weakening just one target, this ability affects every enemy unit with Magic attack. Finally, the Immunity ability makes Kaori Matsune even more interesting at higher levels. It protects the monster from Magic debuffs and Cripple, helping it avoid those negative effects and remain useful for longer. This is particularly helpful when facing opponents who rely on debuffs to weaken our monsters during battle. Combined with its 6 Health at the maximum level, Immunity gives Kaori Matsune some extra staying power.

Overall, Kaori Matsune looks like a solid Legendary monster for players who enjoy strategic Magic-based battles. Snipe helps target important backline units, Silence weakens enemy Magic attackers, and Immunity protects against certain negative effects. Its 5 Mana cost also makes it easier to fit into a variety of lineups without using too much of the available Mana. If you are looking for a monster that can both attack strategically and support your team against Magic-heavy opponents, Kaori Matsune is definitely worth keeping an eye on!

### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about Kaori Matsune. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

### Thanks for visiting my post, hope we meet again!

As I mentioned in my post the other day, my wife and I took a trip this past weekend.  We had wanted to go somewhere earlier in the year when my sister in law and I both turned 50, but at the time she wasn't interested in going anywhere.  Then, a few months later she decided that it might be cool to take a quick weekend trip.  We kicked around a few ideas, and it just so happened that we settled on Austin Texas as our destination.  It just so happened to fall on the same weekend that @mrsbozz and I celebrated our 18th wedding anniversary, so it all worked out really well.


<center>![28119d3a-68b8-40c6-acfa-a86269fc3aad.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/243BbyiVWSrn8pCFzUSbdEAbMixx4wesP27i4gBCTFy8JdxyAZCFqjvHVAx21217dU9du.jpg)</center>

------------------------


We worked a half day on Thursday, then made the four hour drive down to Columbus, Ohio so we could all fly together down to Austin.  Of course, things don't always go as planned, and while we felt we had plenty of time to get down there, we got stuck in traffic and it ended up being cut pretty close.  It turned out a person driving a backhoe in a construction area had accidentally hit the power lines and they had to close down the whole interstate in one section. This backed up traffic for miles.  Obviously, we made it in time, but as soon as we got to our relatives, we had to load up into the car and head for the airport.  Needless to say it was hectic!


<center>![PXL_20261015_215308260.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wCJESTbSGuSkXSyrCb6xYpCiFAFfCQfN2W2UBRYp9aCgGEznDQ976AaMHwkA629uKjf.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

We ended up getting through security a lot quicker than we had anticipated, so we decided to kick the celebratory weekend off with some massively overpriced drinks at the Chili's in the airport.  If you have a sharp eye, you might notice there are five drinks in the photo above.  That was my mistake.  It was one of those use the QR code things to order your food and drinks and I accidentally ordered one too many Modelos.  We ended up splitting it between my brother in law and I.


<center>![PXL_20261016_012921513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23swbmtHXjFL4mGY7veysBdc7kP7wrozz52hNErtCi4UvE8QGbrzW3kGNY9E5GFjPnoJx.jpg)</center>

------------------------

We flew from Columbus to Dallas, then we had a short layover before we made the half hour flight from Dallas to Austin. It ended up being a longer layover than we expected as bad weather was moving through the Austin area and they had to push the flight back a bit.


<center>![PXL_20261016_014452887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23swnH6aGNTtQwnNovCFSMa4RfLWwjZLMeSpk8D8fbAU5g5qyh9gEomxFD5SqshoWv3Ts.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

Which means we didn't arrive in Austin until about 1 in the morning central time.  My brother in law was worried about our rental car not being available, so the first thing he did after we got our luggage was head to the counter.

They had some bad news and good news for us.  The bad news was, the car that our brother in law had rented was no longer available.  The good news was, they were going to upgrade us to make up for it.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xKp7aHsiWQfws29zFMSCf4nWLJ1kY1jou8beUAEpSHmu7HSyFd1AYhQeGSwN3gbKUTx.png)</center>


<center>![PXL_20261016_173450477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wMcgRLBjCJSmsiFZZqrZhDix7MeiiChtmRrEHTnwxWPjCN2VA6NRcYPjqSB9W87o25g.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

We ended up in this pretty sweet Mercedes GLE 350.  It was comfortable and it got us everywhere we needed to go while we were in Austin.  The only drawback was, with a ride this sweet, we didn't get to take advantage of the self driving cars while we were there!


<center>![PXL_20261016_131827564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EoiUoE7BUWeKvUED9NJgxPZtNLXZX5Mf7mAQdzZr3ThXKRMTgKM7BfXCUbtCACFTeZp.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20261016_131817208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/Ep1VsgdqQJ1rC9YSBtfYEZBTwDi3ZYdbJqSK97ZESJKuCcyNB3kk8kxMYbfwTKMHc4U.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20261016_131732226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xVMEFHwCRu4t2S2vsKDhuuFEQgUV3ZK3KCjrrkhFU45SZPaJmKATa8nxv1FhCbMU3R6.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20261016_134626660.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wWps2QBAbU4AiJQ23s4AcijYrghbNkyFamyVkyNMZGUeEE8cX6FC5apyHzca3V2LXai.jpg)</center>


---------------------------------

While my brother in law was in charge of the flights and rental car, I got put in charge of the accommodations while we were down in Austin.  I jumped on Air BnB for the first time in my life, and after a lot of hemming and hawing over price, location, and amenities, I ended up selecting this cool little Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) in the East Austin area.

It was tucked in an alley back behind the owners main house, but it was still pretty private and the fact that it was an ADU wasn't really such a big deal.  The property managers were very nice and responsive to us, and besides the water pressure being really low (something they said they are working on), it was a great place to stay.

Oh yeah, I forgot to mention, I don't have an photos to prove it, but while we had our longer than expected layover in Dallas, I got to try [Whataburger](https://whataburger.com/home) for the first time in the airport.  It was actually quite good and I honestly enjoyed it more than In and Out the one time I had that chain.  I just got the basic cheeseburger, but it was put together really well and it did the trick to fill my empty stomach after a long night of travelling.  

Trust me when I say I have a ton of content to share with you, so I am going to close this post out for now, and let the excitement build for you just a bit more!

---

I've been avoiding learning to knit hats because at some point to make a nice round shape you have to use double pointed needles (DPNs). It's possible to just knit a tube then cinch it all together at the top but it's a bit awkward in my opinion and leaves too much fabric.

For my first hats I decided to use a free pattern called [The Breakwater Beanie by The Purling Pigeon](https://www.ravelry.com/patterns/library/the-breakwater-beanie)

It comes in three sizes which are teen. small adult and large adult. I measured my head and it's 21 inches so I chose the small adult size which is exactly that. Most commercial hats seem a little large on me so I casted on a few less stitches to compensate but unfortunately it still turned out too big (see the grey hat).

I didn't do a gauge swatch so that's probably on me :)





![20261020_090800-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juliakponsford/23vsN2QJZdM7dBfF1SMkCdPrY5vZ6MDyhj4DKAS4eSXzecTf4yuNyML3yhcfYCPx4xBSi.jpeg)

---

I decided to make another one and went my own way but still using the pattern as a base.

Instead of the recommended 4mm needles I used 5 mm but casted on 88 stitches which is less than even the teen size and the end result was a great fit!

It's meant to have a lot of ribbing length that way when you fold it you have a double thick layer over your ears, you can see it here unfolded:

![20261020_090641-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juliakponsford/23vi1x3XA1myEwV9Eyr9j6YiStsxuSgzGDRNS4r6TSY98iAkN1yDmAtacs3ayuJWLGBYH.jpeg)
